markers: | description = When the wearer deals spell damage while illuminated by a light source,{{see bugs}} they also inflict {{Cond|Radiating Orb}} upon the target for 2 turns.

sources.title: Radiating Orb
markers: | effects = * Affected entity has '''-1''' to [[Attack Rolls]] per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it.

summary: Dealing spell damage inflicts Radiating Orb for 2 turns, even in darkness according to the pinned source.

fields.Arcane Radiance: Dealing spell damage applies Radiating Orb for 2 turns. Separate hits of multi-hit spells can apply it repeatedly. The tooltip requires illumination, but the source reports it works regardless of light.
fields.Radiating Orb: The target sheds bright light and takes −1 to attack rolls per remaining turn.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
